title: Emulating physics-based XCO2 retrievals across OCO-2 viewing modes with compact neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.18333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operational full-physics retrieval of the column-averaged dry-air mole fraction of carbon dioxide from satellite spectra is computationally demanding. We use singular value decomposition to compress spectra from the Orbiting Carbon Observatory-2 separately by band. Compact multilayer perceptrons use the resulting spectral scores, prior information, and viewing geometry to predict the difference between the full-physics retrieval and its operational prior. Adding the predicted difference to the prior yields an estimate of the retrieved mole fraction. The models were trained on 2015-2019 observations and validated on 2020 observations. In 2021-2025 tests, the mean annual root-mean-square errors relative to the Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide Observations from Space retrieval product were 0.89, 1.35, and 1.43 parts per million for ocean glint, land glint, and nadir observations, respectively. translated_title: 利用紧凑神经网络在OCO-2各观测模式下模拟基于物理的XCO2反演
translated_abstract: 基于卫星光谱的二氧化碳柱平均干空气摩尔分数的全物理业务化反演在计算上开销巨大。我们采用奇异值分解将轨道碳观测卫星2号（OCO-2）的光谱按波段分别进行压缩。紧凑的多层感知器利用所得的光谱得分、先验信息和观测几何，来预测全物理反演结果与业务化先验值之间的差异。将该预测差异加到先验值上即可得到反演摩尔分数的估计。模型在2015-2019年的观测数据上训练，并在2020年的观测数据上验证。在2021-2025年的测试中，相对于天基大气二氧化碳观测（ACOS）反演产品，海洋耀斑观测、陆地耀斑观测和天底观测的年均均方根误差分别为0.89、1.35和1.43 ppm。
tldr: 该研究通过奇异值分解压缩OCO-2光谱并训练紧凑多层感知器，实现快速模拟全物理XCO2反演，在2021-2025年测试中三种观测模式的年均均方根误差仅为0.89至1.43 ppm。
en_tdlr: This study compresses OCO-2 spectra via singular value decomposition and trains compact multilayer perceptrons to rapidly emulate full-physics XCO2 retrievals, achieving annual mean RMSEs of only 0.89–1.43 ppm across all three viewing modes in 2021–2025 tests.
